review_body: Ramen historians trace the first specialised ramen shop, Rairaiken, to Asakusa in 1910. The original closed in 1976. Fifty years later, on 2 July 2026, Asakusa Rairaiken reopened a short walk from the Tsukuba Express Asakusa Station, The Japan Times reported, which makes Asakusa a fitting stop for noodle-history fans. Pair it with the old-Tokyo snack stalls around the temple district.
